faqItems.q: What happens in the free demo?
faqItems.a: You enter your website address, and Aspen builds a live simulation on a preview of your actual site: she greets visitors by voice and chat, answers questions from your own pages, and shows how she would capture inquiries and book appointments for your business. Nothing is installed and nothing on your site changes — it is a mock-up built from your public pages.

faqItems.q: How long does the demo take?
faqItems.a: About 2 minutes to see Aspen live on your website. Building the full simulation from your site's pages takes around 10 minutes, and Aspen uses that time to learn your business and answer your questions.

faqItems.q: Do you change or hack my website?
faqItems.a: No. Demo mock-up — your website is untouched, nothing on your server is changed. The demo runs on a preview copy built from your public pages, so your live site stays exactly as it is.

items.q: What is the best AI receptionist for a small business?
items.a: The best AI receptionist for a small business answers every call instantly, around the clock, books appointments into your calendar, and sends you a summary after each call. AiHiddenLeads is built to that checklist: Aspen answers by voice and website chat, can appear as a live video avatar, and starts at $99/mo with 400 voice minutes included. The honest test is your own website — the free live demo takes about 2 minutes.

items.q: How much does an AI receptionist cost per month?
items.a: Premium is $99/mo — the permanent price — with 400 voice minutes, website chat, and up to 50 B2B prospects per month included (no specific count is guaranteed). Professional is $199/mo with 1,200 minutes and up to 100 prospects, and Platinum is $349/mo with 2,500 minutes and up to 200 prospects. The $199 setup fee is waived through the end of the month, and Aspen's live video avatar is an optional add-on at $79/mo on any plan — its first month is free.

items.q: Is there an AI receptionist with a video avatar?
items.a: Yes. Aspen, the AiHiddenLeads AI receptionist, can appear on your website as a live, lip-synced video avatar — your AI spokesperson — while she talks with visitors by voice and chat. The avatar is an optional add-on at $79/mo on any plan — and its first month is free; the voice receptionist works on its own if you skip it. You can watch her work in the free live demo on your own website.

items.q: Does an AI receptionist answer calls 24/7 and book appointments?
items.a: Yes. Aspen answers 24/7 — nights, weekends, and holidays — so callers never land in voicemail; 85% of callers who hit voicemail don't call back. She books appointments straight into your calendar, sends confirmations and reminders, and can transfer a caller straight to you when a human is needed.

items.q: How is an AI receptionist different from an answering service?
items.a: A traditional answering service has people take messages — often with a fee for every message or minute — and you call back later. An AI receptionist answers instantly, follows your script the same way on every call, and does the work during the call itself: answering questions, booking the appointment, and sending you a summary with the transcript. At AiHiddenLeads the price is one flat monthly plan with minutes included, not a meter running on every message.

items.q: What is included in Premium for $99/month?
items.a: Premium includes 400 browser voice minutes per month during the current launch promotion, website chat and 50 B2B prospects per month. Professional is $199 with 1,200 minutes and 100 prospects; Platinum is $349 with 2,500 minutes and 200 prospects. Live video is optional and telephone usage is separate.

items.q: Can I try it on my own website before paying?
items.a: Yes. Start the free live demo with your website URL and your name. We learn readable public pages and overlay the assistant on a preview of your actual website. We do not change your live site. Scan and video preparation depend on the site and connection; there is no guaranteed two-minute completion.

items.q: Does a natural AI voice include live video?
items.a: All plans include natural two-way website voice with a still portrait and chat. Live, lip-synced video is an optional add-on at $79/month on every plan, with included video minutes matching your plan (Premium 400, Professional 1,200, Platinum 2,500) — and the first month of the avatar is free.

items.q: Can it answer my business telephone number?
items.a: Website voice is available now. Customer telephone answering and forwarding are available and activated for each business after setup and testing. The intended offer supports after-hours/missed-call or all-call forwarding; Professional and Platinum include one local number and transfer, with phone usage separate at 5¢/minute. Routing, billing and spend caps must be verified before activation.

items.q: Can I connect my calendar or CRM?
items.a: You can book a meeting with our team through our live sales calendar. Your own calendar requires authorization and a verified connection. Admin call-report CSV export and reviewed single-report webhook sending exist; customer CRM synchronization and automated delivery are not live. A real Zapier destination still needs testing.

items.q: Are calls recorded and can I receive a summary?
items.a: Browser calls start with a recording disclosure. Private transcripts, AI summaries and speaker-specific audio segments support internal review; these are not a continuous mixed telephone recording. Visitors can request a transcript/summary link with explicit confirmation. Customer automatic per-call or weekly delivery requires further setup; no automatic marketing enrollment.

items.q: Where do the included B2B prospects come from?
items.a: Business prospects are researched from public business sources by target industry and region, with available contact evidence reviewed. Premium includes 50 per month, Professional 100 and Platinum 200. A prospect is not an opt-in buyer or a guaranteed sale, and not every record has a verified owner email or phone.

items.q: Are SMS and social posting automatic?
items.a: SMS confirmations, reminders and summaries are coming soon, pending carrier approval and separate fees. Social content, scheduling and permitted replies require agreed scope, connected accounts and approval; autonomous posting or messaging is not currently connected here.

Try the website simulation first, then review your business knowledge, voice and appearance in guided setup. Production readiness depends on your website, installation and any authorized calendar or phone connections. We do not promise a fixed deployment deadline.

items.q: Can I cancel, and is there a guarantee?
items.a: Plans are month-to-month. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period; plan changes are immediately prorated. The monthly plan fee has a 14-day money-back guarantee. Review optional service and usage terms before checkout.
